features: Starlight imaging, 120 dB HDR (92 dB per IEC 62676-5)
Intelligent Video Analytics, IVA Pro Buildings and IVA Pro Perimeter
Closed-loop pan/tilt drive (holds position in 170 mph gusts)
ONVIF Profile S, G, T and M
release_notes: Specs per official Bosch datasheet (AUTODOME_7100i_Data_sheet_enUS_101217963787.pdf). Clear-bubble IP66 pendant model. Sensitivity at 30 IRE (F1.6, 1/30). Consumption 48.6 W at PoE 54 VDC (43.2 W at 24 VAC, 46.8 W at 36 VDC). Cloud services: Stratocast Genetec, Bosch Remote Portal. IVA Pro Intelligent Tracking and IVA Pro Traffic are separate licenses.

frigate.notes: Bosch official RTSP scheme: /?inst=1 main, /?inst=2 sub (per Bosch 'RTSP usage with Bosch Video IP Devices'). Default admin user is 'service' (no factory default password — set one first). ONVIF Profile S/G (T/M on INTEOX). Not individually bench-tested.

home_assistant.notes: Generic ONVIF integration; Bosch CPP cameras are ONVIF Profile S/G compliant. Use the 'service' account.

blue_iris.notes: Bosch — use the ONVIF/RTSP (or 'Bosch') profile; default admin user is 'service'.
